definitions.explanation: A large room for gatherings and banquets, typically a wide tatami room in a traditional house, inn or temple.

examples.japanese: {広間|ひろま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広間|ひろま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A banquet was held in the large room of the inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広間|ひろま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: At New Year, the relatives gather in the big room of my grandfather's house.

notes:

- {大広間|おおひろま}: a grand hall; the banquet hall of an inn or castle
